caption:
‘Prepare to meet your God’ sounds like a threat? It's the door still left open. (Amos 4:12 devotional)

The summons to meet God isn't despair — it's an invitation dressed as warning. The God you're told to meet is the God who fights on your side.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Do I brace to meet God as a judge — when He calls me to meet Him as my own?
